title: 7.3.10.1 Pneumatic Cylinder Removal (LOTO, side panel, gripper cover)
summary: Prepare the OptiSweep tipper station for pneumatic cylinder replacement by performing LOTO on the tipper, removing the station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor area, and removing the gripper cover by taking off eight (8) M8 button head screws to expose the pneumatic cylinder assembly.
when_to_use: Use when replacing the tipper pneumatic cylinder and you must safely de-energize the tipper (LOTO), then remove the station side panel (if necessary) and the gripper cover to access the pneumatic cylinder assembly.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs LOTO and the physical removal steps (side panel and gripper cover) using the specified tools and PPE.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO on the tipper before removing the side panel and gripper cover.
access_or_tools_needed: Replacement part: Pneumatic cylinder (for later steps in the full replacement procedure)

system_preconditions: Tipper is ready for lockout/tagout (LOTO) per the manual’s referenced LOTO procedure.
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout procedure location is referenced in the manual section “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” on page 2 (details not included in this packet).

visual_references.description: Figure 7-10: Pneumatic Cylinder assembly diagram used by the pneumatic cylinder removal steps (shows pneumatic cylinder assembly and gripper cover fastener locations).

steps.title: Perform LOTO on the tipper
steps.purpose: De-energize and secure the tipper so side panel and gripper cover removal can be performed safely.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper (manual references the “Operator Station Lockout/Tagout” procedure on page 2).
steps.healthy_condition: Tipper remains in a locked-out state during subsequent physical removal steps.
steps.failure_condition: LOTO is not applied or is removed/invalidated before side panel or gripper cover removal.

actions.label: Apply LOTO to tipper
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: If LOTO cannot be completed/verified, stop and do not proceed to panel/cover removal.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1: PNEUMATIC CYLINDER REMOVAL Step 1: “LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).”

steps.title: Remove the station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the motor area so the gripper cover can be removed.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed, exposing the motor area.
steps.healthy_condition: All nine (9) self-tapping fasteners securing the side panel are removed and the panel can be removed without forcing.
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed because one or more required self-tapping fasteners are still installed.

actions.label: Check whether side panel removal is necessary
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine (9) self-tapping fasteners, stop and re-check that all required fasteners are removed before continuing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 Step 2: “If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.”

steps.title: Remove the gripper cover by removing eight (8) M8 button head screws
steps.purpose: Expose the pneumatic cylinder assembly by removing the gripper cover.
steps.instruction: Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.
steps.expected_result: Gripper cover is removed after taking out the eight (8) M8 button head screws, providing access to the pneumatic cylinder assembly.
steps.healthy_condition: All eight (8) M8 button head screws are removed and the gripper cover comes free without excessive force.
steps.failure_condition: One or more M8 button head screws cannot be removed (e.g., wrong tool fit/size or binding).

actions.label: Remove gripper cover fasteners
actions.exact_action: Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.

stop_or_escalate_if: If any M8 button head screws cannot be removed, stop and verify correct tool fit/size before applying additional force.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.10.1 Step 3: “Remove the gripper cover by removing the eight (8) M8 button head screws.”

success_criteria: Station side panel is removed (if necessary) to access the motor area.
Gripper cover is removed after removing eight (8) M8 button head screws, exposing the pneumatic cylinder assembly.
healthy_conditions: LOTO remains in effect during physical disassembly.
Side panel removal completes only after all nine (9) self-tapping fasteners are removed.
Gripper cover removal completes only after all eight (8) M8 button head screws are removed.
failure_conditions: Side panel cannot be removed because not all nine (9) self-tapping fasteners are removed.
One or more M8 button head screws cannot be removed (before applying additional force).
escalation_guidance: If you cannot complete side panel removal after removing the nine (9) self-tapping fasteners, stop and re-check fastener removal before continuing.
If any M8 button head screws cannot be removed, stop and verify correct tool fit/size before applying additional force.
